Close-up pans/zooms over a vintage printed photograph of five children lined up in front of a Christmas tree.
Rapid synchronized gym posing clips of the five adult siblings, hard cuts on the audio downbeats.
Multi-take montage: low-to-eye-level frontal and profile static shots, smartphone tripod-mounted in mirror shots.
Real-time capture across all shots; pose snaps and arm flares land on the percussive downbeats.
Camera pans and zooms over the physical photograph.
Coordinated static flexes, sequential 'thousand-hand' arm flares, stacked bicep curls, and deadpan stares into the camera or mirror.
Final neutral front-facing lineup in oversized hoodies and streetwear.
The five adults correspond to the five children in the opening photograph; one female and four male siblings persist across shots.
Black tank tops, compression shirts, oversized hoodies, and baggy cargo/track pants recur across the montage.
Each montage shot uses a static low-to-eye-level camera; the mirror shots show a phone on a tripod.
Overhead directional gym spotlighting creates dramatic physique shadows against dark ambient backgrounds.
The photograph section shows flat, scan-like illumination of a printed print rather than scene lighting.
Beyond the primary choreography, no material secondary motion (hair, fabric swing, particles, background motion) was observed.
'pov: the whole family locked in' in white sans-serif with a dark stroke, centered upper frame.
Gym wall signage 'UNGLA...' visible in mirror reflections.
No dialogue; fast rhythmic vocal-percussion track; cuts and choreography snap on its downbeats from 5s onward.
Five identifiable real adults appear.

The rhythmic track is likely licensed music.
